No hardware or RustDesk input was used for control or validation, and no OS input injection was used. Passive device discovery or observation performed by the application is not claimed to be disabled.
No claim of full Ultra parity, arbitrary application compatibility, desktop-wide or same-process independent user isolation.

No mouse-only MCP Start variant was added; missing-keyboard candidate rejection was verified offline with genuine GUI history preservation. Live held-preservation was proved for other malformed/stale/active-automation candidates.
No broad assigned-routing, annotation, magnifier or macro behavior retest; prior accepted groups retained.

Node dragging was not exercised. Named canvas node clicks, real wire selection, accessible controls and arrow pixels were verified. Node positions are session-local arrangement, not persisted or included in topology undo/redo; position persistence was not a promised criterion.

Maximum 64-history boundary, exhaustive graph sizes, arbitrary third-party files, concurrent independent editors/forced stale native acknowledgements, crash/power-loss persistence and hardware device replacement remain unexercised by this live gate.
